notes.title: v1.28 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Do not allow color change after that player has been in a game. Player can leave and re-join game to change color if needed.[/*]
	[*]Improved projectiles controls[/*]
	[*]Improved Steam Controller config[list][*]requires manual update from user via Steam Controller Configurator[/*][/list]
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Assassin mode occasional points awarded on crashed bikers[/*]
	[*]Gamepads firing projectiles for keyboard players[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: v1.27 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
	[*]Added "Dot Obstacles" feature (found in Gameplay Settings menu)
		[list]
			[*]When set to more than 0, this feature will render a set amount of 3x3 "dots" on the game board, in random locations, that players must avoid.[/*]
		[/list]
	[/*]
	[*]Added "Invisible Obstacles" feature (found in Gameplay Settings menu)
		[list]
			[*]When enabled, this feature will make obstacles invisible during gameplay (after the countdown).[/*]
		[/list]
	[/*]
	[*]Added feature to flash player's trail and score when they gain points (can be disabled via Gameplay Settings menu)[/*]
[/list]
